title.en: Clean baths and mixed styling feedback

text.en: Many dog owners visiting the Ray Road salon in Ahwatukee report fresh-smelling coats and tidy nail trims from groomers Naomi and Promise. However, one doodle owner was disappointed that their dog was simply shaved rather than styled after a former groomer left, and another client felt their dog's nails and bath were subpar.

Reviewers frequently praise Naomi and Promise for their warm, courteous manner when checking pets in for baths and nail trims. Although a couple of returning customers express sadness over the departure of former stylist Marisa, they appreciate the friendly attitude and reassurance offered by the current salon staff.

Clients highlight that the groomers handle anxious and energetic dogs with patience during bathing and nail maintenance. Owners note that their pets feel comfortable with Naomi, return home calm after their sessions, and look forward to visiting the Ahwatukee salon for regular upkeep.

q.en: Which groomers do clients mention at the Ray Road Petco salon?

a.en: Recent reviewers praise Naomi and Promise for patient handling and nail trims, while several also note that former stylist Marisa has left.

q.en: How do owners rate the haircut and bath quality?

a.en: Most clients are pleased with baths and nail trims, though one doodle owner noted receiving a plain shave instead of a styled cut.

q.en: What services are available at Petco Grooming on East Ray Road?

a.en: The salon offers full-service baths, breed haircuts, coat treatments, and walk-in nail trims.
